approved_text: Let f(n) be the maximum number of pairs at distance exactly 1 among n points in the plane that form the vertices of a convex polygon. Is f(n) = O(n) as n → ∞?

source_docstrings:
If $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ form a convex polygon then there are $O(n)$ many pairs which are
distance $1$ apart.
